top_signals.title: European gas jumps 3% as Middle-East talks hits stalemate
top_signals.summary: European and British wholesale natural gas prices rebounded on Monday, snapping last week’s sharp pullback as stalled trade talks in the Middle East and a surge in crude oil prices reignited prolonged disruption fears across continental energy hubs.
